properties.name: Hwanung
properties.description: Son of the Lord of Heaven who descended to Mount Baekdu. Father of Dangun. Brought wind, rain, and cloud ministers. Established laws and taught agriculture.

properties.name: Dangun
properties.description: Legendary founder of Gojoseon (first Korean kingdom, 2333 BCE). Son of Hwanung and a she-bear who became human. National ancestor of all Koreans.

properties.name: Jangseung
properties.description: Guardian spirit embodied in carved wooden poles at village entrances. Male and female pairs protect villages from evil spirits and disease.

properties.name: Ungnyeo
properties.description: The she-bear who became human after 100 days of eating garlic and mugwort in a cave. Mother of Dangun, founder of Korea. Represents patience and endurance.

properties.name: San-shin
properties.description: Korean Mountain God, one of the most widely worshipped deities. Each mountain has its own San-shin. Often depicted with a tiger. Shrines exist at most Buddhist temples.
